title: Vacuum Filtration and DNA Extraction from Environmental Water Samples
author: Grace Semabia Kpeli

steps.title: Assemble Filtration Apparatus
steps.instruction: Assemble the vacuum filtration apparatus in a clean workspace, ensuring all components are sterile.

steps.title: Prepare Filter Paper
steps.instruction: Place a Whatman 0.45 µm filter paper onto the filtration membrane support using sterile forceps.

steps.title: Filter Water Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the 1.5 L water sample using vacuum filtration.

substeps.instruction: Pour the 1.5 L water sample into the filtration funnel
Apply vacuum and filter the entire volume
Replace filter paper if it becomes clogged

steps.title: Transfer Filter Paper
steps.instruction: Remove the filter paper with sterile forceps, fold it inward (cell-side in), and place it into a sterile 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Resuspend Microbial Cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend microbial cells from the filter paper using 1X PBS.

substeps.instruction: Add an appropriate volume of 1X PBS to the tube containing the folded filter paper

steps.title: Extract DNA
steps.instruction: Perform DNA extraction using the QIAamp® DNA Mini Kit, using the resuspended PBS as the starting material, following the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Elute the purified DNA in Buffer AE into a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube

steps.title: Quantify DNA Purity
steps.instruction: Assess DNA concentration and purity using NanoDrop.

substeps.instruction: Verify acceptable purity: A260/280 ≈ 1.8–2.0 and A260/230 ≈ 2.0–2.2

steps.title: Confirm DNA Concentration
steps.instruction: Confirm DNA concentration using the Qubit™ dsDNA HS Assay Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store the extracted DNA at -20°C until use.
